patch.value: Switch removes untracked paths absent from the target tree

Installed-CLI stat-cache acceptance exposed that materializeTree deletes every non-ignored working-tree path absent from the target, while switch preflight protects only untracked paths the target would overwrite. A project-local extension registration vanished after switching a repository that had not staged it. This is recoverable in the disposable acceptance but would permanently delete real untracked work.

Switch, merge, undo and reset remove tracked paths absent from the target but preserve every untracked path; an untracked path colliding with a target still refuses before mutation; real repository tests cover nested files and installed project configuration; full coverage remains 100/100/100
Materialization removes only paths owned by the current index and never deletes untracked data.
Switch deleted project-local extension registration because it was untracked and absent from the target tree.
